items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't know about that.

ctx.x: And when I came down, I guess he thought that I had a knife in my hand, so he grabbed this piece of iron and wanted to protect himself with a piece of iron. When he did that, Carney said, "Watch out --he's got a piece of iron in his hand" -- so one of the fellows -- one of the stagehands came back there and grabbed him, you know, and stopped it.
That's when Duke asked him to give his notice, and told Selle to pay him off.
Well, it's good to get the story of what really happened.
